que_es: Self-rating of the day's mood, on a scale from 1 to 10.

como_se_mide_en_vuelo.estacion: Scale from 1 to 10 at the same time every day.
como_se_mide_en_vuelo.transito: Scale from 1 to 10 at the same time every day.
como_se_mide_en_vuelo.superficie: Scale from 1 to 10 at the same time every day.

por_que: HRP risk: behavioral changes and psychiatric disorders. Isolation and confinement disrupt mood, sleep and team cohesion.
cuando_avisar: Personal deviation (layer B, 3.0 or more two days in a row) or downward drift (layer C).
prevencion: Meaningful activities, not just rest; the HRP is studying whether growing plants eases isolation.
fuentes: NASA HRP: Risks of Human Spaceflight
